issues.detail: The Greek 'μαρτυρουμενος' (martyroumenos) is a passive participle meaning 'being testified to' or 'being borne witness against.' The Vietnamese translation 'làm chứng tốt' implies he was giving good testimony/witness, which reverses the direction of the action. In context (Acts 23:10), it means he was being accused/testified against by others.
